observations: A head-like form built from dense black flat shapes sits against a dark green background, angled in a rough three-quarter view facing right.
Thin colored outlines—pink, red, yellow, purple, and orange—loop loosely over the black mass, tracing an ear spiral at left, a nose ridge, and red cross-hatched eye shapes.
The mouth area at lower right concentrates layered orange, pink, and yellow lines around a row of small white vertical marks suggesting teeth.
reading: Black flat shapes stack into a heavy skull-like mass while thin colored lines draped across them feel weightless, almost like annotations laid over a solid form. The bared teeth and red-hatched eye sockets push toward confrontation, but the loose pink and purple loops looping past the jaw soften that edge into something closer to a smirk. Much of the green ground stays visible, giving the figure room to breathe.
contextAngle: Within the owned rawblocks subset, this piece sits between "nnxyz rawblocks #44" and "nnxyz rawblocks #46" by title number. Where #46 fills its form with saturated yellow and teal over purple, #45 keeps most of its surface dark and lets color appear only as thin traces.

connections.reason: Both feature bared teeth and heavy black shapes, but #46 packs its form with bright filled color while #45 leaves the blocks bare, exposing the line work.
#44 uses a hot pink background and far denser overlapping strokes that nearly obscure the face, whereas #45 isolates its figure against green with more open space.

lookingQuestion: Where do the colored outlines follow the edges of the black shapes, and where do they break away to draw their own separate contour?
ambiguities: Gray shapes at upper right may be additional block forms or background elements; their relationship to the head is unclear.
Small marks along the top of the head could read as hair, spikes, or a repeated zigzag pattern—no single reading is certain.
